isolated_component_fit.basis: Actual native rigid component mesh bounds against closed cabinet meshes; countertop, service routes and home installation are separate checks

visual_review.basis: Actual neutral native closed/open previews inspected; attachment, inset reveal, cavity/shelf and operating-state corrections reviewed.
visual_review.limits: Isolated asset presentation; host circulation, product engineering and actual installation remain separate.

analytic_motion_review.basis: Plan rectangles for door leaf/frame/carcass and paired meeting edges sampled at0.01degree increments from0to100degrees
analytic_motion_review.limitations: Original concept geometry; no manufacturer hinge specification or load rating.
